description: Epoch AI 'data-stock' github repo data — stock-of-training-data projections and inputs (compute projection, dataset sizes, web/text corpora).

body.how_to_read: Repo data export for Epoch's training-data-stock work. compute_projection.csv is large (~33 MB, 800k rows). Read each CSV header for columns. Tangential to chip-component spend (kept for completeness). Duplicate `data__`-prefixed copies present in the repo were not copied.

methodology.summary: Data CSVs from the epoch-research/data-stock repo, copied to blobs on 2026-06-12 (CSV-only; non-CSV repo files and exact-duplicate copies skipped). Confidence 0.8 (CC BY 4.0).
